title: 分级 · 初中｜经历叙述与问题处理 · 60 句
description: 社团、出行、人物变化和团队活动；练习时态关系、原因、比较、条件与回顾。

items.zh: 我加入天文社不是因为成绩好，而是因为好奇。
items.en: I joined the astronomy club out of curiosity, not because of my grades.
answers: I joined the astronomy club out of curiosity, not because of my grades.
items.notes: out of curiosity：出于好奇；交代参加活动的动机。

items.zh: 练鼓声太大，我们不得不换了教室。
items.en: The drums were so loud that we had to change classrooms.
answers: The drums were so loud that we had to change classrooms.
items.notes: so ... that：如此……以至于……。

items.zh: 报名以后才知道每周都要排练。
items.en: I found out about the weekly rehearsals only after signing up.
answers: I found out about the weekly rehearsals only after signing up.
items.notes: find out：获知；after signing up：报名后。

items.zh: 我以前只看漫画，现在也读人物传记。
items.en: I used to read only comics, but now I read biographies too.
answers: I used to read only comics, but now I read biographies too.
items.notes: used to 与 now 对照习惯变化；biography：传记。

items.zh: 我们轮流向社员介绍自己的收藏。
items.en: We take turns introducing our collections to the other members.
answers: We take turns introducing our collections to the other members.
items.notes: take turns doing：轮流做；introduce ... to：向……介绍。

items.zh: 姐姐教我弹的第一首曲子非常简单。
items.en: The first tune my sister taught me was very simple.
answers: The first tune my sister taught me was very simple.
items.notes: my sister taught me 修饰 tune，省略关系代词。

items.zh: 为了参加机器人比赛，我学会了使用几种工具。
items.en: I learned to use several tools so that I could enter the robotics competition.
answers: I learned to use several tools so that I could enter the robotics competition.
items.notes: so that 表目的；enter a competition：参赛。

items.zh: 练习一段时间后，我终于能跟上全队的节奏了。
items.en: After some practice, I could finally keep pace with the rest of the team.
answers: After some practice, I could finally keep pace with the rest of the team.
items.notes: keep pace with：跟上……的节奏。

items.zh: 即使作品没有获奖，我也想把它展出来。
items.en: Even if my work wins no prize, I still want to display it.
answers: Even if my work wins no prize, I still want to display it.
items.notes: even if：即使；display：展出。

items.zh: 社团结束了，但我们的讨论一直持续到回家路上。
items.en: The club session ended, but our discussion continued on the way home.
answers: The club session ended, but our discussion continued on the way home.
items.notes: continue：继续；on the way home：回家路上。

items.zh: 我们抵达农场时，主人已经开始喂羊了。
items.en: By the time we reached the farm, the owner had started feeding the sheep.
answers: By the time we reached the farm, the owner had started feeding the sheep.
items.notes: by the time 引导时间从句；had started 表示更早的动作。

items.zh: 虽然船程很短，我却第一次看到了海豚。
items.en: Although the boat trip was brief, it gave me my first sight of dolphins.
answers: Although the boat trip was brief, it gave me my first sight of dolphins.
items.notes: although 表让步；my first sight of：第一次看到。

items.zh: 司机建议我们在小镇停下来吃午饭。
items.en: The driver suggested stopping in the town for lunch.
answers: The driver suggested stopping in the town for lunch.
items.notes: suggest doing：建议做，不能写 suggest to do。

items.zh: 导游给了我们一张画着集合地点的地图。
items.en: The guide gave us a map showing where we should meet.
answers: The guide gave us a map showing where we should meet.
items.notes: showing 作定语；where we should meet 为间接问句。

items.zh: 走到山脚时，我们才发现缆车没有运行。
items.en: We did not discover that the cable car was closed until we reached the foot of the hill.
answers: We did not discover that the cable car was closed until we reached the foot of the hill.
We didn't discover that the cable car was closed until we reached the foot of the hill.
items.notes: not ... until：直到……才……；the foot of：山脚。

items.zh: 比起购买纪念品，我更想跟当地人聊聊。
items.en: I would rather talk to local people than buy souvenirs.
answers: I would rather talk to local people than buy souvenirs.
items.notes: would rather ... than ...：宁愿……而不……。

items.zh: 这趟旅行让我明白，有些地方并不像照片里那么安静。
items.en: The trip taught me that some places are not as peaceful as they look in photographs.
answers: The trip taught me that some places are not as peaceful as they look in photographs.
The trip taught me that some places aren't as peaceful as they look in photographs.
items.notes: not as ... as：不如……那么……。

items.zh: 雨来得太突然，我们只好躲进一家小书店。
items.en: The rain caught us by surprise, so we took shelter in a small bookshop.
answers: The rain caught us by surprise, so we took shelter in a small bookshop.
items.notes: catch someone by surprise：使人措手不及；take shelter：躲避风雨。

items.zh: 我把门票贴进日记，以免忘记参观的日期。
items.en: I stuck the ticket in my diary so I would not forget the date of our visit.
answers: I stuck the ticket in my diary so I would not forget the date of our visit.
I stuck the ticket in my diary so I wouldn't forget the date of our visit.
items.notes: stuck 为 stick 的过去式；so 表示目的。

items.zh: 回程时，大家都睡着了，只有我还看着窗外。
items.en: On the journey back, everyone fell asleep except me; I kept looking out of the window.
answers: On the journey back, everyone fell asleep except me; I kept looking out of the window.
items.notes: except：除……之外；keep doing：一直做。

items.zh: 我的海报被雨淋坏后，同学帮我重新画了一张。
items.en: After rain ruined my poster, a classmate helped me make another one.
answers: After rain ruined my poster, a classmate helped me make another one.
items.notes: ruin：毁坏；another one 替代另一张海报。

items.zh: 我没听清比赛规则，所以请裁判再解释一次。
items.en: I missed part of the rules, so I asked the referee to explain them again.
answers: I missed part of the rules, so I asked the referee to explain them again.
items.notes: ask someone to do：请某人做；them 回指 rules。

items.zh: 修好模型之前，我试了三种不同的连接方法。
items.en: I tried three different ways of joining the parts before I repaired the model.
answers: I tried three different ways of joining the parts before I repaired the model.
items.notes: ways of doing：做某事的方法；before 表示顺序。

items.zh: 有一道题让我卡了很久，直到同桌画了个示意图。
items.en: I was stuck on a question until my desk mate drew a diagram.
answers: I was stuck on a question until my desk mate drew a diagram.
items.notes: be stuck on：被……难住；diagram：示意图。

items.zh: 忘带演讲稿反而让我开始直视观众。
items.en: Forgetting my notes actually made me look directly at the audience.
answers: Forgetting my notes actually made me look directly at the audience.
items.notes: make someone do：让某人做；动名词短语作主语。

items.zh: 当其他人都想放弃时，队长提出再检查一遍线路。
items.en: When the others wanted to give up, the captain proposed checking the wiring once more.
answers: When the others wanted to give up, the captain proposed checking the wiring once more.
items.notes: propose doing：提议做；wiring：线路。

items.zh: 我们把大任务分成小步骤，进度才变得清楚。
items.en: Our progress became clear after we divided the large task into smaller steps.
answers: Our progress became clear after we divided the large task into smaller steps.
items.notes: divide ... into ...：把……分成……。

items.zh: 不是所有困难都能当天解决，这次经历让我懂得了耐心。
items.en: Not every difficulty can be solved in a day; this experience taught me patience.
answers: Not every difficulty can be solved in a day; this experience taught me patience.
items.notes: not every 是部分否定；teach someone something：让某人学会。

items.zh: 问路以后，我们才意识到刚才走反了方向。
items.en: After asking for directions, we realised we were going the wrong way.
answers: After asking for directions, we realised we were going the wrong way.
items.notes: after doing：做过某事后；were going：当时正在走。

items.zh: 问题解决以后，我们把有用的步骤记在了班级留言板上。
items.en: Once the problem was solved, we posted the useful steps on the class message board.
answers: Once the problem was solved, we posted the useful steps on the class message board.
items.notes: once：一旦；post：发布。

items.zh: 搬到这里以后，他比以前更愿意参加集体活动了。
items.en: Since moving here, he has become more willing to join group activities.
answers: Since moving here, he has become more willing to join group activities.
items.notes: since doing 配合现在完成时；more willing：更愿意。

items.zh: 我的朋友不像看起来那么害羞。
items.en: My friend is less shy than she appears.
answers: My friend is less shy than she appears.
items.notes: less ... than：不如……那样；appear：显得。

items.zh: 妹妹以前总需要我提醒，现在却开始提醒我了。
items.en: My younger sister used to need reminders from me; now she reminds me instead.
answers: My younger sister used to need reminders from me; now she reminds me instead.
items.notes: used to 与 now 对照角色变化；remind：提醒。

items.zh: 我起初不喜欢新座位，后来却认识了新的朋友。
items.en: I disliked my new seat at first but later made new friends.
answers: I disliked my new seat at first but later made new friends.
items.notes: at first 与 later 对照前后变化。

items.zh: 他从来不把别人的口音当笑话。
items.en: He never makes fun of anyone's accent.
answers: He never makes fun of anyone's accent.
items.notes: make fun of：嘲笑；accent：口音。

items.zh: 祖母现在会给我们发语音消息了。
items.en: Grandma can send us voice messages now.
answers: Grandma can send us voice messages now.
items.notes: send someone something：给某人发送某物。

items.zh: 我宁愿听实话，即使有时不太好听。
items.en: I prefer the truth, even when it is hard to hear.
answers: I prefer the truth, even when it is hard to hear.
items.notes: even when：即使在……时；说明偏好适用的情形。

items.zh: 我们性格不同，却都喜欢安静地观察。
items.en: Our personalities differ, but we both enjoy quiet observation.
answers: Our personalities differ, but we both enjoy quiet observation.
items.notes: differ：不同；both：两者都。

items.zh: 认识他之前，我没有遇到过这么细心的倾听者。
items.en: Before I met him, I had never known such a careful listener.
answers: Before I met him, I had never known such a careful listener.
items.notes: 过去完成时表示在相识之前的经历。

items.zh: 现在轮到我帮助曾经帮助我的人了。
items.en: Now it is my turn to help someone who once helped me.
answers: Now it is my turn to help someone who once helped me.
items.notes: it is my turn to：轮到我；who 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 队里有人擅长进攻，也有人更会防守。
items.en: Some team members are good at attacking, while others defend better.
answers: Some team members are good at attacking, while others defend better.
items.notes: some ... others ...：一些人……另一些人……。

items.zh: 我没进球，却创造了一个传球机会。
items.en: I did not score, but I created a chance to pass.
answers: I did not score, but I created a chance to pass.
I didn't score, but I created a chance to pass.
items.notes: score：得分；a chance to do：做某事的机会。

items.zh: 裁判吹哨之前，谁也不能开始。
items.en: Nobody can start before the referee blows the whistle.
answers: Nobody can start before the referee blows the whistle.
items.notes: before 引导时间从句；blow the whistle：吹哨。

items.zh: 看台上的鼓励声让我们继续跑了下去。
items.en: The encouragement from the stands kept us running.
answers: The encouragement from the stands kept us running.
items.notes: keep someone doing：让某人持续做；stands：看台。

items.zh: 这场比赛教会了我如何接受公平的失败。
items.en: This match taught me how to accept a fair defeat.
answers: This match taught me how to accept a fair defeat.
items.notes: how to accept：如何接受；defeat：失败。

items.zh: 受伤以后，他改为帮助教练记录比赛数据。
items.en: After his injury, he helped the coach record match data instead.
answers: After his injury, he helped the coach record match data instead.
items.notes: instead：转而；record data：记录数据。

items.zh: 我们不是速度最快的队，却是配合最好的队。
items.en: We were not the fastest team, but we worked together best.
answers: We were not the fastest team, but we worked together best.
We weren't the fastest team, but we worked together best.
items.notes: fastest 与 best 分别比较速度和配合。

items.zh: 如果明天操场仍然积水，训练就改到室内。
items.en: If the playground is still flooded tomorrow, we will train indoors.
answers: If the playground is still flooded tomorrow, we will train indoors.
items.notes: if 从句用现在时表达将来的条件。

items.zh: 队长听取了替补队员的意见，而不只听主力队员的。
items.en: The captain listened to the substitutes as well as the regular players.
answers: The captain listened to the substitutes as well as the regular players.
items.notes: as well as：也；substitute：替补。

items.zh: 终场以后，双方队员互相握了手。
items.en: After the final whistle, players from both sides shook hands.
answers: After the final whistle, players from both sides shook hands.
items.notes: shake hands：握手；shook 为过去式。

items.zh: 我的日记不只写发生了什么，还写我当时的感受。
items.en: My diary records not only what happened but also how I felt.
answers: My diary records not only what happened but also how I felt.
items.notes: not only ... but also ... 连接两个名词性从句。

items.zh: 照片没有拍出山路实际有多陡。
items.en: The photograph does not show how steep the mountain path really was.
answers: The photograph does not show how steep the mountain path really was.
The photograph doesn't show how steep the mountain path really was.
items.notes: how steep：多么陡；间接问句用陈述语序。

items.zh: 回头看，我为一件小事担心了太久。
items.en: Looking back, I spent too long worrying about something minor.
answers: Looking back, I spent too long worrying about something minor.
items.notes: spend time doing：花时间做；looking back：回顾时。

items.zh: 我以前觉得长大意味着什么都能自己做。
items.en: I used to think growing up meant doing everything on my own.
answers: I used to think growing up meant doing everything on my own.
items.notes: used to think：以前认为；on my own：独自。

items.zh: 这段经历最让我难忘的是陌生人的善意。
items.en: What I remember most about the experience is a stranger's kindness.
answers: What I remember most about the experience is a stranger's kindness.
items.notes: what 引导主语从句；kindness：善意。

items.zh: 如果再参加一次，我会更早与搭档商量。
items.en: If I took part again, I would discuss things with my partner earlier.
answers: If I took part again, I would discuss things with my partner earlier.
items.notes: if + 过去式，would + 动词原形，表达假设。

items.zh: 有些细节是听别人讲了以后才想起来的。
items.en: Some details came back to me only after I heard other people's accounts.
answers: Some details came back to me only after I heard other people's accounts.
items.notes: come back to someone：重新想起；account：叙述。

items.zh: 我没有完成全部目标，但比出发时更了解自己。
items.en: I did not achieve every goal, but I knew myself better than before I set out.
answers: I did not achieve every goal, but I knew myself better than before I set out.
I didn't achieve every goal, but I knew myself better than before I set out.
items.notes: not every：并非全部；set out：出发。

items.zh: 那天我们留下的不只是照片，还有一段共同的回忆。
items.en: We left that day with more than photographs; we shared a memory.
answers: We left that day with more than photographs; we shared a memory.
items.notes: more than：不止；shared memory：共同回忆。

items.zh: 我想把这件事讲清楚，而不是把自己写成英雄。
items.en: I want to tell the story clearly rather than make myself its hero.
answers: I want to tell the story clearly rather than make myself its hero.
items.notes: rather than 对照叙述目的；make someone something：把某人写成某种角色。
